keptBy.browserCloseTab: That combination is kept by the browser (close the tab)
keptBy.browserCloseWindow: That combination is kept by the browser (close the window)
keptBy.browserNewTab: That combination is kept by the browser (new tab)
keptBy.browserNewWindow: That combination is kept by the browser (new window)
keptBy.browserPrivateWindow: That combination is kept by the browser (private window)
keptBy.browserQuit: That combination is kept by the browser (quit)
keptBy.browserReload: That combination is kept by the browser (reload)
keptBy.browserReopenTab: That combination is kept by the browser (reopen a tab)
keptBy.copy: That combination is kept by Copy
keptBy.cut: That combination is kept by Cut
keptBy.paste: That combination is kept by Paste
keptBy.systemCloseWindow: That combination is kept by the system (close the window)
keptBy.systemSwitchApps: That combination is kept by the system (switch apps)
movesFocus: {key} moves the focus and closes dialogs, so it cannot be a shortcut
needsModifier: Use Ctrl, ⌘, Alt or Option with the key, or a function key (F1 to F12), so typing into cells keeps working
